environment: Tribute 24 trips Tribute 8 at the central water cache and shoves the heavy tank from its stand. It lands on Tribute 8, causing fatal injuries. Tribute 24 takes water flask.
The water cache leaves Tribute 9 beside a heavy tank when Tribute 1 trips the approaching tribute. Tribute 1 topples the tank onto Tribute 9, killing Tribute 9, then claims water flask.
At the central water supplies, Tribute 1 trips Tribute 6 beneath the tank’s stand. A shove brings the heavy tank down with fatal force. Tribute 1 collects water flask.
Tribute 15 trips Tribute 17 beside the central water cache, then shoves the heavy tank from its stand. It lands on Tribute 17, causing fatal injuries; Tribute 15 leaves with water flask.
Tribute 4 pushes a cracked pillar onto Tribute 6 inside a ruined hall, pinning them beneath the stone and causing fatal injuries.
escape: Tribute 13 swings a sharpened scrap at Tribute 9 over the central supply crates. Tribute 9 ducks beneath the swing and kicks a loose crate into the path, escaping the attack empty-handed.
The central tool rack provides Tribute 11 with an iron bar. A swing catches Tribute 12 in the head with fatal force. Tribute 11 gathers rescue rope before leaving.

Tribute 1 grabs Tribute 11's collar in The Center Podium and drives a jagged fragment into the shoulder. Tribute 11 ducks out of the loose outer layer, leaving it in Tribute 1's grip while escaping with an untreated shoulder wound.
Tribute 2 wrenches a loose iron bar from the central tool rack and strikes Tribute 7 in the head. The blow kills Tribute 7; Tribute 2 takes rescue rope.
Tribute 5 swings a sharpened scrap at Tribute 10 over the central supply crates. Tribute 10 ducks beneath the swing and kicks a loose crate into the path, escaping the attack empty-handed.
selfDeaths: Tribute 18 edges along the narrow ledge in The Mountains. The outer lip breaks beneath their feet, sending them down the cliff. The fall is fatal.

Tribute 10 searches a cracked stairwell in the Center Podium. The landing tears away from the wall, sending them into the basement. The fall is fatal. Tribute 10's death adds another name to the ruined stairwell, where Tribute 23 died before.

Tribute 1 crosses a cracked landing in the ruined stairwell in The Center Podium. The slab gives way at the wall, carrying them down with it. Tribute 1 does not survive the fall. Tribute 1's death adds another name to the ruined stairwell, where Tribute 10 died before.
A dry limb lies across a forest route marker. When Tribute 5 moves it aside, the branch above loses its support and falls, killing them.
Tribute 8 pushes through brush in The Forest and blocks a boar's way out. It charges through them; Tribute 8 falls and dies from the wounds.
unusedWeapon: Tribute 2 lies flat to squeeze beneath a low boundary wire in The Center Podium. Tribute 19 approaches from the blind side and holds the exposed face against the ground until Tribute 2 suffocates.

At a steep cut bank in The Center Podium, Tribute 15 lunges upward and cuts Tribute 19's thigh with a metal scrap. Tribute 19 slides down the far slope rather than attempt a fight, surviving with a bleeding thigh.

Tribute 19 lures Tribute 24 and Tribute 15 beneath a damaged supply platform in the Center Podium, then pulls its last support from outside. The platform collapses onto them. Both die beneath the frame before either can crawl free.

Tribute 16 and Tribute 19 grapple for the higher end of a rubble ridge in The Mountains. Tribute 16 gives up the height to pull Tribute 19 down onto an exposed reinforcement spike, causing a fatal chest wound.
Tribute 11 offers Tribute 16 a hand as though proposing a truce in The Mountains. The handshake becomes a pull onto a concealed broken tile, whose point opens a fatal neck wound.
weapon: Tribute 7 turns back to remove a trail marker in The Center Podium, allowing Tribute 15 to close in and fires a crossbow bolt into Tribute 7's chest; the crossbow wound kills them beside the disturbed marker.

Loose rubble shifts under Tribute 15 in The Center Podium as Tribute 15 fires the crossbow toward Tribute 1; the broken footing spoils the crossbow attack, letting Tribute 1 retreat without being struck.

Tribute 21 cuts Tribute 24 across the side with the hand axe as Tribute 24 squeezes between two boundary posts in The Center Podium; Tribute 24 keeps going through the gap and braces its loose crossbar behind, escaping with a bleeding side.

Tribute 20 fires an arrow into Tribute 21's side while Tribute 21 balances on a dry drainage lip in The Center Podium; Tribute 21 drops safely to the lower course and follows it out of sight with the side bleeding.

Tribute 14 tries to climb a steep bank in The Center Podium to avoid a fight, but Tribute 1 strikes Tribute 14 in the head with the wooden club before the crest is reached; the wooden club attack is fatal.

methodology.rounds: Unique phase indices, including opening and finale; zero-death phases count. Day/night rates use only the corresponding phase kind, excluding finale.
methodology.length: Final calendar day, not wall-clock play time. Finale assignment rounds can share a calendar day.
methodology.loot: Acquisition facts, including gifts and recovery; not just newly created items.
methodology.movement: Individual tribute move facts, including each member of group travel.
methodology.combat: Keyword estimates over whole event passages; fights include conflict/finale categories, credited kills and attack wording. Categories overlap. Interviews excluded. Samples in fightExamples.
methodology.repetitions: Exact full passages after masking player and region names; events and interviews separate. Within-game repeats exclude the first occurrence in each game. No fragment or semantic matching.
methodology.seeds: Each batch uses seed-0 through seed-(completed-1). Lore disabled. Cast and settings are recorded per batch.
